BRIGHAM EXPLORATION CO filed a tender offer statement (Form SC TO-T) with the SEC on Sep 29, 2008, launching a formal offer to acquire shares of Undisclosed.

Form SC TO-T is required under Section 14 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
summary: BRIGHAM EXPLORATION CO launched a formal tender offer to acquire a publicly traded company. The SC TO-T filing was submitted to the SEC on Sep 29, 2008.
